settings/tournament.name: The Inter-Club Ping Pong Championship (6 Clubs)
settings/tournament.conditions:
### Inter-Club Ping Pong Championship
Welcome to the official Inter-Club Table Tennis Championship! 6 clubs compete on the Single Official Competition Table in a high-stakes Knockout & Draw format: 3 opening draw clashes (3 vs 3), followed by a 1 vs 1 Semi-Final and a Direct Finalist draw, culminating in the Grand Finale!

#### Tournament Format & Structure (Single Table)
- **Single Table Setup:** All tournament matches take place consecutively on the single official table.
- **Stage 1 (Draw Knockout — 3 vs 3):** A public blind draw pairs the 6 clubs into 3 knockout clashes. 3 winning clubs advance; defeated clubs are eliminated.
- **Stage 2 (Direct Finalist Draw & Semi-Final):** Among the 3 advancing clubs, 1 club is drawn directly into the Grand Finale, while the other 2 clubs face off head-to-head (1 vs 1) in the Semi-Final match.
- **Stage 3 (The Grand Finale):** The direct finalist plays the Semi-Final winner to determine the tournament champion.
- **Match Format:** Single set to 11 points per match (first to reach 11 points wins).
- **Deuce Rule:** At 10–10, play continues until one player achieves a 2-point lead (e.g. 12–10, 13–11).
- **Rest Breaks:** 3 minutes between consecutive matches to allow players to warm up.
- **Points System:**
  - 🏓 **Win:** 1 Point (Winner advances)
  - ❌ **Loss:** 0 Points (Knockout elimination)
  - 🚫 **No Draws:** Every table tennis match ends in a decisive victory.

#### Tournament Progression (5 Matches in Order)
- **Stage 1 (Elimination Clashes):** Clash 1 (Pair 1) | Clash 2 (Pair 2) | Clash 3 (Pair 3)
- **Stage 2 (Direct Bye & Semi-Final):** Semi-Final Match: Winner A vs Winner B | Direct Finalist: Winner C
- **Stage 3 (The Grand Finale):** Championship Match: Direct Finalist vs Semi-Final Winner

#### Official Table Tennis Rules & Conduct
- **Service Alternation:** Alternates every 2 points (every 1 point after 10–10 Deuce).
- **Legal Service Toss:** Ball rests on open flat palm, tossed vertically at least 16 cm without spin, struck as it falls.
- **Let Serve:** Serve touching the net and landing legally is replayed with no penalty.
- **No Volleys:** Striking the ball on the fly before it bounces forfeits the point.
- **Table Contact:** Free hand (non-racket hand) must not touch the table surface during rallies.
- **Edge Balls:** Top surface edge is in play; sides/underside are out.
- **Referee Authority:** The Table Referee supervises all matches on the single official table.
